purpose: Audited exceptions for generate-api-contract invariants. Every entry needs a reason and the phase that sanctioned it; an entry suppresses exactly one flagged item.

entries.label: schema:AttendanceMarkRequest.version newly-required
entries.reason: Enforce the existing stale-write contract for manual attendance: include the roster registration version; stale batches return 409 and roll back all marks/audits. Web and E2E callers migrate together. Missing version returns 400. Kongming identified and recommended this bounded repair on 2026-10-22.

entries.label: schema:UpdateEventRequest.version newly-required
entries.reason: Restore the agreed optimistic-concurrency contract: draft edits must include the last-read version and stale edits return 409. No existing web/mobile draft-update caller exists; missing-version requests now return 400. User-authorized defect repair after independent review, 2026-10-22. No other compatibility exception is granted.

entries.label: schema:CreateApplicationRequest.cycle newly-required
entries.reason: fec7d958 intentionally tightened boundary validation (@NotBlank @Size(max=60)) so an application write without a cycle is rejected 400 at the controller. Team Lead ruling on the MP36 stop gate 2026-10-30: narrowing is deliberate, not a drift artifact.
